caption: The drawing features a rectangular panel with a red background and a thin, double-lined border near the edges. At the center, there is an oval-shaped medallion with a blue background and a yellow border that contains the Latin inscription "ENSE PETIT PLACIDAM SUB LIBERTATE QUIETEM." Inside the medallion stands a person with dark brown skin, wearing a white tunic and a red headdress, holding a spear in their right hand and a staff or stick in their left hand. Surrounding the medallion are various decorative elements: at the top, there are large yellow flowers with green leaves as well as a broken chain and a hand holding a curved sword emerging from the flowers; at the bottom, there are green leafy branches, a drum, two flags with different colors, and the shaft of a spear or lance. The entire composition has a formal, symmetrical arrangement with the medallion in the center, floral elements at the top and bottom, and the decorative objects radiating outward.
title: Tavern sign
